description: The FAIRiCUBE project deposits a topographic wetness index raster for Luxembourg City. Zenodo lists a public 10-metre Cloud Optimized GeoTIFF whose filename identifies 2019, under CC BY 4.0. Wetness indices describe where terrain tends to concentrate water and can help choose spatial assumptions for urban runoff, stormwater-drainage or flood-exposure simulations. The page gives the city and map title but does not state the elevation source, flow-routing algorithm, numerical range or whether 2019 is an observation year, not a product label. It is a terrain-derived indicator, not a flood map or measured soil saturation. Those missing methods must be resolved before treating the cell values as calibrated drainage capacity. No related catalogue record explicitly covers this city layer. The GeoTIFF was not downloaded, so its projection, nodata mask and actual 10-metre cell geometry were not checked.
name: Topographic Wetness Index of the City of Luxembourg
